title: Smoky Pine Nut Stir Fry
description: A French-inspired stir fry dish with smoky flavors from bacon and a crunchy nut topping, all cooked in a wok.
instructions: 1. Cook the bacon in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat until crispy. Remove from heat and set aside.
2. Add olive oil to the wok and cook the green beans and red bell pepper until tender-crisp, about 4 minutes.
3. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
4. Stir in soy sauce and cooked bacon. Cook for 1 minute.
5. Add the pine nuts and stir-fry until lightly toasted, about 2 minutes.
6. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
7. Serve immediately and garnish with additional pine nuts if desired.
